item.description:
# Weft 1.0.6
- Simplified service controls: Start/Stop is the primary button, Open stays beside it, and Restart and Build/Rebuild are available in the three-dot menu and by right-clicking. - Fixed overlapping Pattern UI builds during Pi startup and restarts. Pi now owns its Pattern UI build; restart Pi to rebuild changes consumed from compiled output. - Made process tracking and automatic recovery resilient to delayed exit callbacks and interrupted startup. - HTTP readiness checks now verify a successful response instead of only checking an open port. - Rebuilds pause dependent services and restore them in dependency order. Stopping during a build prevents automatic restoration. - Retired old Weft-owned Pattern UI watchers safely and rejected recipes that would reintroduce the conflicting watcher. Cleanup preserves manually started processes.
